verdict.rationale: Kong's Dev Portal explicitly lets developers 'browse and search API documentation, try API operations, and manage their own credentials' (kong-docs-21), backed by OpenAPI/AsyncAPI-based publishing (kong-docs-47) and an API spec directory (kong-docs-9), which matches an interactive, runnable API reference. However, this is all first-party doc description with no hands-on/independent corroboration, and a probe found no live OpenAPI endpoint discoverable on the main docs domain (kong-probe-2). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the 'try it out' runnable feature, and a public live example of the Dev Portal in action.
